name: Witch Doctor Graven Effigy reaches enemies within 20 yd
contract: Graven Effigy 506635 summons creature 50122; its tooltip says 'Enemies within $504761s1 yds have the
duration of crowd control effects on them increased by $504767s1%'. $504761s1 is Shadow Effigy 504761
Effect[0] BasePoints -21 + 1 = -20, shown as 20, so the tooltip states 20 yd (G-1, read literally; the
cycle 9 B13 fix round keeps Graven at its own 20 yd). The effigy AI scans Nearby(me, 10.0f) for
NpcGraven and casts the field 504767 on each valid enemy (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:530-540); the
fix scans 20 yd. No data radius gives 10 yd: 504767 has EffectRadiusIndex 18 (15 yd) and 10 (30 yd).
Layout along +x from the doctor; the effigy stands 1.5 yd from the doctor at 1.6 rad from the facing
(Summon, Summons.cpp:202-206), read at 5.26, 20.10 and 26.09 yd from the dummies (the Shadow Effigy
catalog reads 20.10 and 45.07 for the same layout). Edges from the effigy add both combat reaches
(dummy 1.275, effigy model 25017 at most 2.5): 10 yd reaches at most 13.775 yd, 15 yd at most 18.775,
20 yd at least 21.275 and at most 23.775, 30 yd at least 31.275. Primary (5.26) is inside 10 yd in both
builds; inside (20.10) is reached only by 20 yd, neither by 10 nor by 15; outside (26.09) is beyond 20
yd and inside 30 yd, so a 30 yd scan fails too. Reads at one instant 3100 ms after the instant cast: the
effigy pulses at once and every 1000 ms and renews the field for 2200 ms, so three pulses have run.
Graven Effigy: instant, StartRecoveryTime 1000, no RecoveryTime, 20% of base mana (311 in final07).
